fact: The head of the technology and information department of the General Administration of the Civil Registry, Colonel Dr Haj Hamad Abdelmalik al-Jaali, says the Ministry of Interior, through the General Administration of the Civil Registry, recovered the civil registry database of more than 120 million records electronically in 63 days, working from a secured data centre in Red Sea State, and that without it birth certificates could not be issued for children born during the war; the article carries no date in its text, so the publication date reported for it (8 November 2024) is used.
title: السجل المدني ينقذ السودان من الرجوع إلى العصر الحجري
